audience.text: Python developers who need to inspect, modify, and save Adobe Photoshop document metadata, layers, masks, blend modes, and image resources without rendering.

capabilities.text: PsdImage exposes width, height, channels, bits_per_channel, color_mode, version, is_psb, layer_count, resource_count, compression, and image_data_kind.
capabilities.title: Document metadata inspection

capabilities.text: Layer objects provide name, bounds, top/left/bottom/right, width, height, opacity, is_visible, clipping, blend_mode_key, channels_count, and channel_information.
capabilities.title: Layer model access

capabilities.text: BlendMode enum and LayerBlendModeMapper map 4-character PSD keys to enum values for reading and writing blend modes.
capabilities.title: Blend mode handling

capabilities.text: LayerMaskDataShort and LayerBlendingRangesData expose raw length and basic properties; mutations are not supported.
capabilities.title: Mask and blending ranges

capabilities.text: ImageResourcesSection parses unknown resources preserving raw payloads; UnknownResource offers resource_id, name, and data.
capabilities.title: Image resource parsing

capabilities.text: PsdImage.save preserves all unmodified sections, enabling lossless save-load cycles.
capabilities.title: Byte-exact round-trip saving

capabilities.text: Loading works with streams that do not support seeking, using BigEndianReader and PsdSectionReader.
capabilities.title: Non-seekable stream support

limitations.text: ChannelInformation is read-only; writing raises NotSupportedException.
LayerMaskDataShort and LayerBlendingRangesData mutations are not supported.
Pixel decoding is not performed; image data is exposed only at the structural level.

problems_solved.text: Enables non-destructive inspection and modification of .psd/.psb files by exposing document structure, layers, resources, and image data without pixel decoding.
Supports byte-exact round-trip saving to preserve unmodified sections and maintain file integrity across save-load cycles.
Works with non-seekable streams, enabling use in constrained I/O environments.

product_summary.text: Aspose.PSD FOSS for Python is a pure-Python library for reading, inspecting, and saving Adobe Photoshop .psd/.psb files without rendering.

uncertainties: Whether the library supports saving .psb files beyond .psd is not explicitly confirmed by facts.
The exact set of supported color modes beyond those implied by ColorModes is not stated.
Whether layer blending ranges can be modified and saved is unclear from the available symbols.
The behavior of PsdImage.save when the document is large or uses unsupported compression is not specified.
Whether ICC profile data can be read or written is not confirmed beyond has_icc_profile and is_icc_profile_untagged flags.
The scope of supported image resources beyond UnknownResource is not detailed.
Whether the library supports loading from memory buffers without file paths is not confirmed.
The exact set of exceptions raised during malformed file parsing is not fully listed.

workflows.name: Load and inspect layers
workflows.text: Load a .psd file using PsdImage.load, then iterate over its layers to access name and bounds.

workflows.name: Modify layer properties
workflows.text: Change layer properties such as name, visibility, opacity, blend mode, or bounds; changes are tracked and preserved during save.

workflows.name: Inspect image resources
workflows.text: Access image resources via PsdImage.resources or PsdImage.image_resources to read known and unknown resource blocks.

workflows.name: Parse image data structure
workflows.text: Read RLE or ZIP compressed image data sections without decoding pixels, exposing structure metadata.
